MATLAB.name: MATLAB
MATLAB.description: Generates and submits MATLAB jobs (single node, optional parallel pool and GPU). Manage mode like Generic: workflow actions, job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU/GPU monitoring charts, processes) and logs.
MATLAB.author: Marinus Pennings

tamulauncher.name: tamulauncher
tamulauncher.description: Tool to run a large number of sequential or multi-threaded commands in a single job
tamulauncher.author: Marinus Pennings

Generic.name: Generic
Generic.description: Generic Slurm environment that should work on any cluster running Slurm. Shared create/manage pages, common Slurm parameters, module picker, workflow actions (rerun/cancel), job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU/GPU monitoring charts, processes) and logs.
Generic.author: Marinus Pennings

AlphaFold.name: AlphaFold
AlphaFold.description: This env allows researchers to generate and submit AlphaFold workflows. It can generate both AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 jobs.
AlphaFold.author: Marinus Pennings

LAMMPS.name: LAMMPS
LAMMPS.description: Analyzes a LAMMPS input file, suggests compatible LAMMPS modules and acceleration strategies, and generates the batch job. Manage mode shows a status strip, a run report, live charts of YAML thermo output, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU/GPU monitoring charts, processes) and logs. Currently only available on the TAMU ACES cluster.
LAMMPS.author: Richard Lawrence

Parabricks.name: Parabricks
Parabricks.description: This environment allows researchers to run Parabricks through a graphical interface. Env is available on ACES and Grace.
Parabricks.author: Owen Schillaci, Victor Valdez

Python.name: Python
Python.description: Sets up a Python environment (module, private, new or shared virtual env, managed with ModuLair) and runs a Python script. Shared create/manage pages like Generic: Slurm checks, workflow actions, job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU/GPU monitoring charts, processes) and logs.

PyTorch-Lightning.name: PyTorch-Lightning
PyTorch-Lightning.description: PyTorch Lightning training jobs using the cluster Lightning module. Single and multi-GPU, DataLoader-based CPU sizing, TensorBoard and a training dashboard.

WorkflowHistory.name: WorkflowHistory
WorkflowHistory.description: Browse, rerun and delete the workflows of all environments recorded in the Drona database.
